tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyung ngur gdams pa rnams bzhugs so//

bla ma mkhyen// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus gcig bsdus pa// snyigs dus 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal// rje btsun chen po chos kyi rgyal po la// lan gcig min par snying nas gsol ba 'debs// sngon nas bsgrubs pa bdag gi lha yi skal// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar dgu'i nyams// 'jigs byed dus mtshan gdan la rnam par 'gyings// lha mchog khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /e ma da lta snyigs ma'i dus// dam chos bshes gnyen rgyang du bor// sdig dang zas nor 'bad pas sgrub// mar 'grib dus su skyes pa'i mi// bdag 'dra thos bsam dman pa dang*// zas gos spyod pa'ang gang byung spyod// gang dran thal thol smras pa la// shes ldan rnams kyis khrel mi 'tshal| |bsod nams tshogs chen bsags pa'i mthus// rigs 'phags lha yi gdung 'dzin khyod// don gyi snying po len 'dod na// dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams// nye ring spangs la rgya chen bskyed// de nas rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i// mdun du gyad dang seṅge'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgyal// cha lugs thub pa chen po ste// 'khor du bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// dkon mchog gsum po'i tshogs rnams ni// sprin phung lta bur gsal byas nas// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig bshags shing*// rang gzhan dge la yi rang bskyed// bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs su// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*| |sems can kun gyi don byed cing*// don gnyis 'gruub pa kho nar shog /gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du// dkar phyogs dge ba'i las 'grub cing*// mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi ba dang*// chos bzhin dge ba'i las 'grub shog /ces dang*/ gzhan yang rang gzhan bla med kyi// don 'gyur smon lam rgya chen gdab/ slar/ bla ma 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i ngos// 'dzum mdangs ldan pas legs byin te// smin grol dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs nas// 'od kyi gong bur gyur par bsam| |de nas dmigs med ngang la bzhag

/rjes su 'khor gsum yongs dag bya// maṅga laṃ// 'jig rten 'di na mkhas dang grub pa yi// shes ldan dam pa rnams kyis bdag 'dra yi// blo dman thos chung rnams la dgongs ma khrel// dad stobs snying rus ldan pa rgyal sras kyi// sku ngo ma chog gang dran bris pa 'dis// thub pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa 'di rgyal sras pas rje btsun dam pa chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po de nyid snang brnyan chos dbyings su thim pa'i gser gdung bzhengs par ti ser chas pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyung du zhig dgos zhes par/ bya bral dkon mchog ming 'dzin gyis rang lo bcu'i thog tu bkod pa rdzogs so/// / ༈ /gnas mchog tsā ri dang gnam mtshor 'byon pa'i mched grogs mang bar gnang ba/ ma gyur 'gro ba rnams kyi don slad du| |dkar po dge ba'i las ni ci byed kyang*// dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed gces// de nas ston pa'i gsung bzhin so thar gyi// bslab ba bzung zhing byang chub spyod pa spyad// pha rol phyin drug sogs kyi nyams len rnams// tshul bzhin sgrub pa skyes bu chen po'i lam// de don thugs su chud par 'dod rnams kyis// tshe 'di blos btang sgrub rgyu'i snying po la// tho rangs snga cha bde ba'i stan 'dug nas// byang chub mchog gi sems ni yang dag bskyed// gang yin yi dam bskyed cing bsnyen pa'i mdun// rin chen seng khri padma nyi zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma padma 'byung gnas kyi// skur gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi tshul bskyed// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin// g.yon pas tshes bkang bhandha sku la brten// gsang yum mtshon pa'i kha ṭwāṃ 'gying zhing bsnams// dar zab lhab lhub phod chen chos gos gsol// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang sprul pa yi// mtshan brgyad ma dang mkha' 'gro dkon mchog gsum// sprin gyi phung po lta bur gsal ba'i mod// dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi// kun bzang mchod la 'dren pa'i mchod sprin ni// sna tshogs nam mkha'i khyon bkang rab bkram 'bul// phyag dang maṇḍal sdig bshags yi rang dang*// 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bar// gsol ba 'debs shing dge ba bsngo ba sogs// gzhan yang don gnyis 'grub pa'i smon lam dag

/theg dman nyan rang lam du mi btang bar// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam yang dag ni// rgyas dang bsdus pa ji ltar byed kyang rung*| |don gnyis mthar phyin phyin ci ma log gdab// de rjes dbang bzhi rgyud bzhi dag par blang*// rdzogs rim dmigs med ngang la mnyam par bzhag /'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i rgyas 'debs rnams/ khyed cag rnams kyi nyams len rgyun 'khyer mdzod// de 'bras thub bstan 'gro la phan byed shog /'di'ang grags pa phun tshogs can tsā rir lo gsum gyi dam bca' ba gsum dang*/ byang gnam mtshor 'gro mkhan gu ru phun tshogs can bzhi la/ skya min ser min gyi bya bral 'bri ras rang lo bcu gcig gi dus su byin/// / ༈ /ma gyur 'gro ba rnams kyi don slad du// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// gang mos yi dam sku ru gsal btab la// de mdun mkha' la rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// chos sku rdor 'chang rin chen rgyan phreng can// g.yas g.yon rdor dril bsnol thabs 'dzum mdangs bzhad// de la dwags po brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas yi dam chos skyong rnams// mkha' la sprin phung 'khrigs ltar gsal bar bskor// skyabs mchog de dag mdun du rang gzhan don// 'bad med myur du 'byung ba'i smon lam dang*// phyag 'tshal yi rang bskul dang rdzogs bsngo bya// phyin ci ma log 'di ltar nyams len 'tshal// de ltar 'dod gsol rjes su thun bsdu na// dbang bzhi gsang sngags spyi ltar tshul bzhin blangs// dmigs med ngang la yeng med ngo bo skyongs// 'khor gsum yongs dag bsngo bas rgyas 'debs dang*// bkra shis bzang pos dus kun 'da' bar mdzod// ces pa 'di'ang ras chung phug pa'i dge slong ngag dbang rin chen don grub kyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor dgos gsungs par/ shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog phun tshogs rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/
rang lo bcu gsum gyi thog tu 'on rin chen brag tu byin pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
